Deprecated alias of `send NAME TEXT`. Gives a named agent a turn (starts a run with its home restored, or follows up on its idle run)

Usage: cua agent tell [OPTIONS] <NAME> <TEXT>

Arguments:
  <NAME>
          

  <TEXT>
          

Options:
      --embedded
          Use an embedded runtime even when a daemon runs

      --daemon <DAEMON>
          Daemon address (socket path or loopback URL)
          
          [env: CUA_DAEMON=]

      --daemon-token <DAEMON_TOKEN>
          Daemon token (loopback URLs)
          
          [env: CUA_DAEMON_TOKEN]

      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>
          Sandbox state directory (embedded; default ~/.cua/sandboxes)

      --json
          Print JSON

  -h, --help
          Print help

Examples:
  cua agent tell ada "what did you learn yesterday?"
